selection_basis: Remaining S&P MidCap 400 issuers by official MDY holding weight, then S&P SmallCap 600 issuers by official SPSM holding weight, with SEC Company Facts snapshots, after SEC (company_tickers_exchange) and exchange-listing identity checks. Fund holdings are a selection basis, not an index-membership certification. Sectors: MDY GICS where given; otherwise the sector held by tracked companies with the same SEC SIC code, reviewed and corrected per company (sector_basis).
